## 311 Citizen Service Requests & Real-Time Case Tracking (Rich Data)
- [311 Citizen Service Request Portal](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/services/request): Centralized intake for all non-emergency municipal issues across roads, waste, parks, water, and by-law. Generates automated `CASE-2026-XXXX` tracking numbers.
- [Real-Time 311 Case Status Tracker](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/services/track): Live tracking portal for municipal work orders with a 4-stage lifecycle:
  1. **Received (New):** Request logged in central municipal queue.
  2. **Crew Assigned (Assigned):** Dispatched to area maintenance supervisor.
  3. **Work in Progress (InProgress):** Field crew or inspector on site.
  4. **Completed & Resolved (Closed):** Work finished, verified by foreman, and closed.
- **Detailed 311 Categories, Rules & SLAs:**
  - **Potholes & Road Surface Hazards (FAQ: "I want to create a service request for a pothole — what information do you need?"):**
    - **Answer / 7 Required Data Points:**
      1. Exact Location: Specific street address (e.g., 148 Valley St) or main road + nearest cross-streets (e.g., Baker St between Maplewood Ave and Ridgewood Rd).
      2. Travel Direction & Lane: Northbound, Southbound, Eastbound, or Westbound; center travel lane, tire path, curb lane/gutter, or crosswalk.
      3. Size & Severity: Tier 1 (<25cm shallow pitting), Tier 2 (25-60cm / 1-3" deep standard hole), or Tier 3 (>60cm / >3" emergency rim-damage crater with exposed gravel/rebar).
      4. Jurisdiction Check: Verification whether local road or Essex County roadway (Springfield Ave, Valley St, and Wyoming Ave are County-owned and cross-routed).
      5. Hazard Conditions: Standing water concealing cavity, sharp asphalt edges, or bicycle/pedestrian lane encroachment.
      6. Digital Photographs: Wide-angle road context shot and close-up depth scale photo.
      7. Reporter Contact: Full name, mobile phone (for SMS alerts), and email for automated tracking number (`CASE-2026-XXXX`).
    - Response SLAs: Emergency Tier 3 / travel lane craters patched within 24 hours. Standard Tier 1-2 repaired within 3 to 5 business days.
    - Duplicate Suppression: Automated consolidation of reports within 50 meters and 30 calendar days to prevent duplicate crew dispatches.
  - **Missed Curbside Waste & Recycling:**
    - Resolution SLA: 2 business days.
    - 5:00 PM reporting rule: Reports accepted strictly after 5:00 PM on scheduled collection day. Earlier reports are rejected.
    - 7:00 AM setout rule: Bins must have been set at the curb prior to 7:00 AM to qualify for municipal re-collection.
    - Required: Address, stream (Garbage, Blue Box, Green Bin, Yard Waste), setout time.
  - **Streetlight Outages & Damaged Poles:**
    - SLA: 5 to 7 business days for bulbs/fixtures; 24 hours for exposed wiring.
    - Required: 6-digit pole tag stamped on the pole (format `ML-XXXX`, e.g. ML-0412) or nearest street address.
  - **Park Hazards, Broken Bins & Boulevard Trees:**
    - **FAQ: "There is a broken garbage bin in the park. Can I report it?"**
      - Answer: YES. Report via 311 Citizen Portal (`maplewoodnj.gov/services/request`) under category `Park Infrastructure / Damaged Receptacle`. Provide park name (e.g., Memorial Park, DeHart Park, Borden Park) and specific landmark (playground, tennis courts). Response SLA: Broken/damaged barrels repaired/replaced within 24 to 48 hours; overflowing bins emptied within 4 hours.
    - SLA: 48 hours for immediate hazards (broken play structure, hanging branch); 10 business days for tree pruning inspection.
    - Jurisdiction rule: Town maintains trees within 4.5 meters (14.8 ft) of the road curb. Private property trees are owner responsibility.
  - **Illegal Dumping & Neighborhood Waste Enforcement:**
    - **FAQ: "Someone is illegally dumping waste in my neighborhood. What should I do?"**
      - Answer: If active dumping in progress, call Police Dispatch at (555) 123-7623 or 911 immediately; record vehicle plate/make and departure direction without confronting the dumper. For discovered abandoned waste, submit a 311 report (`maplewoodnj.gov/services/request`). Sworn Code Enforcement officers conduct forensic debris searches (invoices, shipping labels). Under Township Code § 209-14, violators face mandatory court appearance, fines up to $2,500 per incident, full municipal cleanup restitution, and possible vehicle impoundment.
    - **FAQ: "Garbage has been piling up near my house. Can I submit a complaint?"**
      - Answer: YES. Unsanitary waste accumulation violates Township Code § 209-7 and Chapter 239 (Property Standards). File a complaint on 311 or call Code Enforcement at (973) 762-8120 Ext. 3300. An inspector conducts a site visit within 24 hours and issues a 48-Hour Notice of Violation. If unabated, town crews clean the refuse, placing a tax lien against the property along with daily $250 court summonses.
    - **FAQ: "There is a bad smell coming from a public garbage area. Can I report it?"**
      - Answer: YES. Report under `311 Public Sanitation / Odor & Health Hazard`. DPW dispatches power-wash sanitization crews within 24 hours using hot water and hospital-grade biodegradable enzymatic deodorizers. Commercial food dumpsters must have tight-fitting lids and rodent-proof drain plugs under § 209-18.
    - Anti-Scavenging: Rummaging through curbside recycling bins is illegal under § 209-11; materials become town property once set at curb (fines up to $500).
  - **Water Quality & Pressure Concerns:**
    - SLA: 2 to 4 business days. For emergency water main breaks call (555) 123-9287 immediately.
  - **General Inquiries & By-law Concerns:**
    - SLA: 3 business days response time.

## Core Municipal Services
- [Department of Public Works (DPW) & Recycling Center](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/services/public-works): Facility at 359 Boyden Ave. Dual-stream recycling by section (Sec 1-2 Mon, Sec 3-4 Tue, Sec 5-6 Wed), biannual bulk drop-off days (furniture, mattresses, MRPs with 2 Maplewood IDs; no construction debris), 4 rotating fall curbside leaf pickup rounds (zero plastic bags, gas-powered leaf blowers banned), spring rake-out (max 4-foot branch bundles), street sweeping, tree removal permits (>8-inch diameter), Jitney commuter train shuttle ($95/yr), free mulch/compost, and electronics e-waste depot.
- [Waste & Recycling](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/services/waste): Curbside setout by 7:00 AM. Missed pickup reports accepted only after 5:00 PM (2-day resolution SLA). Green bin organics weekly, blue box recycling bi-weekly, household garbage bi-weekly (max 2 bags without tag, $3.00 for each extra tag). Bulk pickup 1st Tuesday of each month (max 2 items). Hazardous waste depot at 450 Transfer Rd open Saturdays 9 AM - 3 PM.
- [Roads & Snow Removal](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/services/snow): Chapter 257 (§ 257-36.7 & § 257-2.5) enforces emergency no-parking restrictions on 22 designated snow corridors (Valley St, Wyoming Ave, Ridgewood Rd, Springfield Ave, Boyden Ave, Parker Ave, Maplewood Ave, Baker St, Prospect St, Tuscan Rd, Burnett Ave, Elmwood Ave, Harvard Ave, Jefferson Ave, Clinton Ave, Hilton Ave, Dunnell Rd, Oakview Ave, Meadowbrook Pl, Claremont Ave, Highland Ave, Indiana St). Parking permits suspended on snow-covered roads. Unoccupied vehicles towed under § 257-31 ($60 fine + towing/storage). Sidewalk snow/ice clearing required within 24 hours (§ 239-1); depositing snow onto cleared streets is prohibited (§ 239-2). Overnight parking ban 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM (Dec 1 – Mar 31).
- [Water Services](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/services/water): Supplied from protected Maplewood Aquifer. Conservation restrictions May 15 to Sept 15: alternate day odd/even watering permitted strictly between 6:00–8:00 AM and 7:00–9:00 PM. Emergency water main dispatch: (555) 123-9287.
- [Animal Control](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/services/animals): Annual dog licensing required ($30 spayed/neutered, $45 intact). Maximum 2.0m leash in all public areas under By-law 2020-04.

## Property Taxes & Finance
- [Property Taxes](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/taxes/info): 2026 Residential Mill Rate is 0.0094523 (48% Municipal, 34% Regional, 18% School Boards). Interim due dates: Feb 27 and Apr 30, 2026. Final due dates: June 30 and Sept 30, 2026. Late penalty: 1.25% per month.
- [Tax Payment Methods](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/taxes/payment): Online banking (Payee: "Town of Maplewood - Property Taxes", 19-digit Roll Number), Pre-authorized debit, in-person at 123 Main St, or 24/7 North drop box.
- [Tax Calculator](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/taxes/calculator): Interactive estimator using the 0.0094523 rate.

## Building & Planning Permits (Sparse Data - Basic Inquiries Only)
> Notice: Permit data on this website is intentionally high-level, minimal, and non-exhaustive. Full building code specifications, setbacks, and engineering criteria are handled directly through Town Hall.
- [Building & Planning Permits Overview](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/building): General construction and structural alterations may require municipal permits. Contact Building Department at (555) 123-4567 ext. 250 for details.
- [Deck Permits Notice](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/decks): High-level intake for residential decks. Consult building officials for current setbacks. Basic intake: [Apply](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/apply/deck).
- [Pool Permits Notice](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/pools): Preliminary inquiry for residential pools and hot tub enclosures. Basic intake: [Apply](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/apply/pool).
- [Burn Permits Notice](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/burn): Limited seasonal open-air burn permits for rural agricultural properties only. Basic intake: [Apply](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/apply/burn).
- [Permit Application Portal](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/permits/apply): Minimal online intake forms for preliminary permit routing.

## Legislative Documents, Operational Manuals & By-laws
- [Comprehensive Municipal Permit, Required Documents & 311 Service Request Manual (PDF)](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/documents/Maplewood_Municipal_Permits_and_Construction_Code_Guide.pdf): Official municipal manual (MW-PERMITS-311-GUIDE-2026-REV3). Comprehensive 8-chapter guide covering New Jersey UCC building permits, itemized required documents by permit type (decks, swimming pools, fences, additions, tree removal Ch. 227 checklists, street dumpster permits $50/7-day, and road cuts), and citizen 311 service request intake standards for potholes, missed waste, and streetlights.
- [Comprehensive Municipal Manual on Recycling, Solid Waste Disposal & Resource Recovery (PDF)](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/documents/Maplewood_DPW_Recycling_and_Waste_Disposal_Comprehensive_Manual.pdf): Official municipal regulatory manual (MW-DPW-RECYCLE-2026-REV5). Authoritative 8-chapter guide covering dual-stream curbside schedules, 359 Boyden Ave recycling center rules, bulk drop-off regulations, leaf vacuuming, public waste enforcement & illegal dumping (§ 209-14 fines up to $2,500), broken park bin reporting SLAs, neighborhood refuse accumulation 48h abatement, and public garbage odor sanitization sweeps.
- [Resident Guides & Publications](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/documents/guides): Curbside Calendar, Deck Construction Manual, Pool Safety Handbook, Resident Welcome Kit.
- [By-laws Index](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/documents/by-laws): Noise By-law 2024-12, Traffic & Parking By-law 2023-88, Property Standards By-law 2023-45, Pool Enclosure By-law 2022-18, Open-Air Burn By-law 2021-09, Animal Leash By-law 2020-04.
- [Master Fee Schedule](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/documents/fees): Complete schedule of municipal fees under By-law 2026-02.
- [Council Minutes](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/documents/minutes): Official municipal council proceedings and resolutions.
- [Raw Municipal JSON Dataset](https://mapplewood-fictional-town.onrender.com/data/townData.json): Raw structured data payload for scraping.
